svg.text: Photon background fraction at which it adds as much counting noise as the dark counts, at the best level
A. Equal-time off run: f N eps = 2 b
N: signal rate, counts/s at the valley level
f = 50 %, top of the operator's range
B. Dark known: f N eps = b
N: signal rate, counts/s at the valley level
f = 50 %, top of the operator's range
Above a curve, the photon background contributes more to the on-run counting noise than the dark counts do; below it, the dark counts dominate. Shaded: the operator's range f
= 0.01 % to 50 %. At N ~ 1 count/s the dark counts dominate the noise for any f in that range; at N = 10 the photon background takes over from f ~ 30-70 %, at N = 100 from
~8-9 %, at N = 1000 from ~3-6 % (equal-time off run). Either way the best level only moves as N -> N (1 + f).
eps(v) from room-light scans (light 13:59, light 17:24); b(v) from the 2026-11-10 dark scans (dark 13:20, dark 16:36), fitted by selftest._smooth_dark_rate. R8486 at ~1000 V
(operator; HV not in the files). The photon background is a MODEL: fraction f of the signal, same pulse heights, absent from the off run.
